about: Post a fractional catalog cost to minor units. Cost is numeric(14,6) on the server: a case of 12 at $5.00 is $0.416667 a unit, and rounding that to cents per unit corrupts margin reporting within weeks. It rounds exactly once, at the moment it is posted.

cases.name: six decimal places, rounded once
cases.about: 0.416667 of a dollar is 41.6667 cents, which posts as 42.

cases.name: the rounding happens once, on the total, not per unit
cases.about: Twelve units at 0.416667 is 5.000004 dollars, which posts as 500. Rounding each unit to 42 first and multiplying would give 504 — four cents of margin invented out of nothing, on every case received.

cases.name: a cost with no decimal part
exactly half a cent rounds up
just under half a cent rounds down
a negative cost keeps its sign
cases.about: A credit from a vendor is a negative cost, and it must round away from zero like every other amount.

cases.name: a large receipt posts through a wider intermediate
cases.about: The posted cents fit in bigint, while scaled cost times cents times quantity does not fit in a signed 64-bit intermediate.

cases.name: a cost that is not a number is refused
